|lore=A capture cable is a quick and effective way for bounty hunters to suddenly snare their target.
|game_text=Deploy on table. Your bounty hunter present may capture a just-forfeited character. Once per turn, you may ▲ an Effect with “Bounty” in its title. Bounty may deploy on captives at non-prison sites. Whenever you collect a bounty, you may take any one retrieved card into hand; place Bounty Effect out of play. Double Back is a Used Interrupt. (Immune to Alter.)

|notes=Set 8 was released 24 November 2004. [https://web.archive.org/web/20041204170841id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/interior.htm Release announcement]. The November 2005 replacement names Bounty rather than an Effect with that word in its title. It retains non-prison deployment. The remaster drops that branch, specifies an opposing same-site forfeiture and makes removing the bounty Effect the cost of taking a retrieved card. Double Back and Alter immunity remain.
